preconditions.description: k is an integer between 0 and 10000 inclusive.
m is an integer between 1 and 300000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in the output is exactly m.
Each line in the output contains exactly 8 digits.
Each line in the output consists of digits only.
All tickets in the output are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(is_k_lucky(ticket, k) for ticket in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each ticket in the output is k-lucky.
